idea: 1 кадр: маленька дівчина в червоному плащі відчиняє величезні двері старого замку. 2 кадр: вона заходить у величезну бальну залу, зала видна вся, дівчина маленька на її фоні, і каже: "Hello? Is anyone still here?"

script.title: The Empty Ballroom
script.logline: A small girl in a red cloak breaches the doors of an abandoned castle ballroom to see if she is truly alone.
script.setting: Cavernous gothic castle ballroom with colossal arched ceilings, decaying chandeliers, and massive dark oak doors.

characters.name: Clara
characters.look: Small pale ten-year-old girl with dark raven hair peeking from under an oversized, vibrant crimson hooded cloak, wearing scuffed brown boots.
characters.voiceDescription: Clear, quiet young female voice, mid-childhood, neutral accent, tentative and hushed.

shots.visual: Clara, a tiny figure in her bright crimson hooded cloak, plants her boots and heaves open a towering, ancient oak castle door.
shots.motion: Slow tilt up from Clara's small hands straining against the weathered timber to the immense gothic door frame cracking open.

shots.visual: A monumental ballroom spans out with towering ribbed vaults and hanging cobwebbed chandeliers, with tiny Clara standing at the grand entryway dwarfed by the architecture.
shots.motion: Locked-off wide view capturing the scale of the endless hall as Clara steps forward into the dim moonlight.
shots.speaker: Clara
